subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The evidence in the murder case ______ presented before the jury.
solution:
The correct answer is: **was**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the use of the given helping verbs.
 
 
• **Had **is used to form the **past perfect** when two events happened in the past, with one past action having occurred even before the other past action.
